With time you will notice that your pot gets crowded with baby haworthias which are called pups. For propagation cut off these pups from the mother plant and place them in a different pot when the pups are one third the size of the mother plant.
Repot your haworthia once a year. This will ensure that your succulent gets fresh soil and ample room to grow.
